finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Alkane, Alkene und Alkine nomenklatorisch korrekt benennen, Strukturformeln einschließlich Skelettformeln skizzieren, homologe Reihen bilden und einfache Isomerien unterscheiden.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can correctly name alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes, sketch structural formulas including skeletal formulas, form homologous series, and distinguish simple isomerism.

Der ganze gewöhnliche Zielkörper bleibt unverändert. Die C4/C5-Fälle unterscheiden Valenz, Bindungsordnung und Konnektivität; die Karte nennt ihre acyclische Ein-Mehrfachbindungs-Grenze. synthesis.rationaleEn: Informed technical synthesis after the sealed genuine independent first passes A and B; no additional independent vote. The whole ordinary goal body is unchanged. A: Naming, skeletal representation, homology and simple isomerism are linked through the same carbon connectivity. PDF page 7 distinguishes the downstream recall selection from the oxygenated-class successor. C4/C5 cases test valence, bond order and connectivity; the card states the acyclic single-multiple-bond limitation. B independently explains: Structural formulas and unambiguous names specify connectivity and bond order. Homologues differ by CH2; constitutional isomers share a molecular formula but differ in connectivity. Observable performance: The learner names and sketches butane, 2-methylpropane, but-1-ene and but-1-yne, counts H atoms using valence and explains why only the first two are constitutional isomers. Transfer: With fresh C5 structures, the learner explains pentane/2-methylbutane isomerism versus pentane/butane and pent-1-ene/but-1-ene homology; rotating a drawing does not create new connectivity. Both complete original reasons and evidence chains remain byte-exact. This rebinds only the current downstream memory context, adding no first-time strict closure or source/course/P/A/M/V/human clearance. Four indirect/partial and nine residual source/course conditions remain open.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Structural formulas and unambiguous names specify connectivity and bond order. Homologues differ by CH2; constitutional isomers share a molecular formula but differ in connectivity.
